stepAnswer: There is exactly one winner per game.
stepBody:
Nikhil writes the following lines of code as part of his exploratory data analysis. Under what condition will Nikhil’s code print True?
counts $$=$$ darts[darts["win"] $$==$$ 1]["game\_id"].value\_counts()
print(sum(counts $$ 
eq $$ 1) $$==$$ 0)
choices: Each player only plays in each game once.
Each player has won at least one game.
There is exactly one winner per game.
There are no repeated values of game\_id.
Every game has at least one winner.
